SELECT NVL(COUNT(*), 0) FROM TRADETRANSACTION t JOIN users b ON t.BUYERIDX = b.USERIDX JOIN users s ON t.SELLERIDX = s.USERIDX
AND t.TRADESTATUS = #{status}

SELECT t.TRADEIDX AS "tradeIdx", t.PRODUCTIDX AS "productIdx", p.TITLE AS "productTitle", b.USERID AS "buyerId", b.NICKNAME AS "buyerNickname", s.USERID AS "sellerId", s.NICKNAME AS "sellerNickname", t.TRADEPRICE AS "tradePrice", t.SAFETYFEE AS "safetyFee", t.TOTALUSED_POINT AS "totalUsedPoint", t.TRADESTATUS AS "tradeStatus", t.TRACKINGNUMBER AS "trackingNumber", t.RECIPIENTNAME AS "recipientName", t.RECIPIENTPHONE AS "recipientPhone", t.SHIPPINGADDRESS AS "shippingAddress", TO_CHAR(t.TRADEDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "tradeDate", TO_CHAR(t.SHIPPINGDATE,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "shippingDate" FROM TRADETRANSACTION t JOIN users b ON t.BUYERIDX = b.USERIDX JOIN users s ON t.SELLERIDX = s.USERIDX LEFT JOIN product p ON t.PRODUCTIDX = p.productIdx WHERE t.TRADEIDX = #{tradeIdx}
